name: Sayonara no Hohoemi
source:
Our guy received a plane ticket to a resort island in the mail. What good is that when he has no money to spend there? Luckily, his boss want him to go to that island to do some work. There, he need to work to make money to go places and chase one of 8 girls, including his childhood girl that followed after him. Can he say goodbye to a girl with a smile after three weeks or so?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403171040/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wns.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
男主收到一张度假岛机票。可他没钱在那里消费，这张票又有什么用呢？幸运的是，老板让他去那座岛工作。为了赚够四处游玩的钱，并追求8名女孩中的一人，他必须努力工作，其中还包括一路追随他的青梅竹马女孩。三周左右后，他能否带着笑容向某位女孩道别？

[来源：[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403171040/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wns.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
